Kinematics (Integration Method)

Reversing: $v = \int a\,dt$, $s = \int v\,dt$ Given $a(t)$, find $v(t)$ and $s(t)$ Constant acceleration formulas Finding time when stationary Maximum displacement using derivatives Total distance travelled via integration
